services.name: Crossfit Classes
services.desc: Every class is coached. Every workout is scaled to your level. Whether you are brand new to CrossFit or have been at it for years, this is the gym where you actually want to show up. CrossFit is a strength and conditioning program built around functional movements performed at high intensity. That sounds technical, but in practice it means you will run, row, lift, squat, press, pull, and push in workouts that change every day. No two days are the same, and that is the point. The program is designed for universal scalability. The same workout that challenges a competitive athlete is adjusted for someone walking into a gym for the first time.
